title: Discharge content only in a day-of-discharge progress_note (wrong kind, no discharge summary) plus nursing instructions; bradycardia, home, 50 days after discharge

rationale.final_diagnosis: EDGE (wrong kind): the diagnosis appears only in a progress note, which this summary-only rule does not accept; the note itself says the discharge summary is still to be dictated.
rationale.hospital_course: EDGE (wrong kind): course is only in the progress note.
rationale.discharge_condition: EDGE (wrong kind): condition is only in the progress note.
rationale.disposition: EDGE (wrong kind): 'Discharged home today' is only in the progress note; the rule accepts the discharge summary or case management note, and nursing instructions do not state a disposition.
rationale.discharge_meds: EDGE (wrong kind): medication list is only in the progress note and nursing instructions.
rationale.med_changes: Nursing instructions state stopped metoprolol and diltiazem and new amlodipine.
rationale.pending_results: EDGE (wrong kind): 'Pending Results: None' is only in the progress note.
rationale.goals_of_care: EDGE (wrong kind): code status is only in the progress note.
rationale.info_transmitted: EDGE (wrong kind): only the progress note says a copy of the note was sent to the PCP; no accepted document shows the discharge summary was sent.
rationale.dp_evaluation: No discharge planning evaluation in any accepted document.
rationale.authenticated: EDGE (wrong kind): the signed document is a progress note; no discharge summary exists to be authenticated.
rationale.timeliness: No discharge summary exists 50 days after the 2026-10-08 discharge.
rationale.meds_consistent: Nursing instructions exist but there is no discharge summary medication list to match against (unclear also defensible).
